svg.aria-label: Two ways to connect ChatGPT and Meta Muse to Salesforce, Jira, NetSuite and SharePoint. With one MCP server per app, every assistant wires to every server, with separate sign-ins, permissions and logs for each. With one governed CData Connect AI gateway, both assistants connect once, and the gateway handles permissions, the signed-in user’s access and a query log for those apps and hundreds more.
svg.text: One connection, one set of rules, one log
